Name: Chest Digspot (Natural Color)
Author: MissMochi
Description:
This is a color edit for vvillow's "Artifact Digspot Variations" chest digspot. It gives the chest a more natural color, compared to the original red with yellow stripes.

To install, drag everything from the Content folder into your Stardew Valley content folder.

(Original texture by vvillow. Texture edit by MissMochi.)
